dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's been a lot of hiring going on around the harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Tvrdo
dialogues.text: Hmm, yeah... But we won't have to concern ourselves with that sort of backbreaking work in the future. The lads and I have set up a company that manufactures those, uh, kuuvahki devices.

dialogues.speaker: Tvrdo
dialogues.text: When that time comes, we can borrow the power of these iron beasts ourselves to move things around. That's a whole lot better than just using the beasts by themselves, haha!
